state:
**Goal `ldap`, Stage 10 (the feature proofs) is under way.** Stages 1 to 5 and 7 to 9 are done; Stage 4 lacks only a CA a program supplies, and Stage 6 lacks only wiring the schema into the readers. `Core\Ldap`, `Core\Ldap\Filter`, `Core\Ldap\Dn`, `Core\Ldap\Sid`, `Core\Ldap\Ad` and `Core\Ldap\Change` owe nothing: every member has an `about.md`, three examples, an attack, a bench with a recorded figure in `docs/perf/members.ndjson`, and a `covers:` marker on a Rust test (and on a `.nvst` case for an instance member).

**Every flag reader is a feature that owes every proof.** `data/proofs/policy.json` has no exclusion by kind, so the 24 features of `Core\Ldap\Ad\AccountFlags` and the 9 of `Core\Ldap\Ad\GroupType` each owe an `about.md`, three examples, an attack and a bench. Their tests are done. **No program can build a flag object without a live entry** (only `Entry::accountFlags` and `Entry::groupType` return one), so their examples, attacks and benches wait for the `samba-ad` footing too, with `Connection`, `Entries`, `Entry` and `Changes`.

**A proof program can now say `// requires: samba-ad`.** `servicesFor` in `tools/nv/proofs/run.ts` runs `docker compose -f tests/db/compose.yaml up -d --wait samba-ad` once per process before the first program carrying it; `spawnProof` throws the reason when that fails, and the example, attack and `--bless` paths turn it into a plain FAIL. The three tree READMEs document the marker. Nothing yet carries it, and the domain is still empty.

**A filter nests at most 100 levels** (`rule:core-classes/ldap-filter-is-a-value`). **How proofs run with no server today**: the root `nvs.toml` has an `[ldap.corp]` block at `ldaps://127.0.0.1:1`, a closed port, and one `[[app]] entry` per proof program that needs a grant. In a proof program, a catch variable or a `var` reused in one file with another type does not compile (E0406): name each `LogicError` catch `$refusal` and each `Throwable` catch `$error`. An instance member's `covers:` line in a `.nvst` case goes at the end of the `--FILE--` block.

next.title: the feature proofs, the `samba-ad` footing the user decided on

items.text: **A seed step writes one fixed set of users and groups into the empty `EXAMPLE.TEST` domain** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`; the service is `tests/db/compose.yaml:375`), so every `.out` is stable. It is idempotent, runs as part of the service coming up healthy (so `servicesFor` at `tools/nv/proofs/run.ts:85` needs no second step), and the names are neutral (`Staff`, `Shop`), never a reporter's.

**The root `nvs.toml`'s `[ldap.corp]` points at the container's LDAPS port with the test CA** (line 2719 of the root file; the service is `tests/db/compose.yaml:375`), and the `Core\Ldap::connect` and `open` examples that print the closed-port error gain `// requires: samba-ad`, are rewritten to show a real sign-in, and are re-blessed.

**The first class proved against the live directory: `Core\Ldap\Entry`** (`bun nv proofs --id 'Core\Ldap\Entry::toArray'` prints the paths; the members are at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs:682`), each program carrying `// requires: samba-ad`.

backlog: **Decided by the user: `Connection`, `Entries`, `Entry`, `Changes` and the two flag classes prove themselves against the real `samba-ad` service**, never through a skip entry in `data/proofs/policy.json`. After the footing lands, each class gets its `about.md`, examples, attack and bench.

`Ad::memberOf` with a string does not check that the string is a DN: `memberOf('not a DN')` returns `(memberOf=not a DN)`, which matches nothing (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/search.rs`, `nvs_core_ldap_ad_member_of`).
Every `Dn` member parses the slot text again (`crates/nvs-stdlib/src/ldap/dn.rs`' module doc), so walking up an n-level DN with `parent` is O(n²).
`nv try` does not apply an `[[app]]` grant from the root `nvs.toml`, so a probe of a granted member needs `nv proofs --bless` instead (`tools/nv/cmd/try.ts`).
Stage 4: a CA a program supplies to `Ldap::open` (`docs/agent/goals/ldap.md`).
Stage 6: wiring the schema into the readers (`crates/nvs-ldap/src/schema.rs`).
